{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders since they are not actual conversions
# A conversion is a completed order that was not refunded
completed_only = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
# Conversion rate = number of converted orders / total completed orders in segment
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(
    total_orders='count',
    converted_count='sum'
).assign(
    conversion_rate=lambda x: x['converted_count'] / x['total_orders']
)

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Print results
print(conversion_rates_sorted)

# Return the segment name
highest_segment"}
